decision_rule.fail: G_size2 fails at either x: 300 K stays excluded; the 300 K law level is scope-labelled 'level carried from 700-1100 K HNEMD' (scope_limit entry); no factor change.
decision_rule.pass: G_size2 passes at both x: re-apply the seq-85 rule (analyze_sizefree.py logic, unchanged) with the 300 K points included. If the branch is still correct_level and the new median rho is within 5% of 1.281: strengthen the seq-90 correction and drop the '300 K excluded' note. If still correct_level but more than 5% away: correct the level factor to the new median. Any other branch: apply that branch as defined at seq 85.

gate: G_size2(x): the 16x8x8 Fe = 1e-4 point (>= 2 passing runs) agrees with BOTH the 8x8x8 Fe = 1e-4 point and the 8x8x8 Fe = 2e-4 base point, for x = 0.15 and x = 0.85
paper: P1 (law level at 300 K); P2 (a follow-up purchase that closes a gap a pre-registered rule left open)
point_rule: a (x, T) point needs >= 2 passing main runs; estimate = seed mean, SE = max(seed SE, pooled within-run SEM / n)

predictions.PrC1: no 16x8x8 Fe = 1e-4 run fails gate R4 (kappa < 2000 W/mK): no runaway at half the driving force
predictions.PrC3: with 300 K included, median rho stays in [1.2, 1.4] and CV <= 0.15 (branch correct_level)
